files.title: Image URLs
files.description: Direct links to the images (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF).

background.title: Background colour
background.description: Leave empty for transparent. Any CSS colour, e.g. #ffffff for Amazon/Shopee/Tokopedia-style white. JPG uses white when empty.

cropToSubject.title: Crop to the subject
cropToSubject.description: Trim the empty area around the subject.

hardEdges.title: Hard edges
hardEdges.description: Crisper outline for products and logos; leave off for hair and fur.

maxWidth.title: Max width (px)
maxWidth.description: Shrink larger images first. Empty = original size.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger files are skipped with an error (not charged).
